Platform Features

EVERYTHING YOU NEED
TO SHIP AT SCALE

One dashboard. Every courier. Full control.

Real-Time Tracking

Know exactly where every parcel is. Live status updates synced directly from courier APIs — visible to you and your customer.

Track a parcel →

Multi-Courier Booking

Book with Leopards, M&P, TCS, Daewoo, Trax, or Daak from one screen. Compare rates, pick your courier, and book in seconds.

Start booking →

Instant COD Payouts

Receive your COD payment the moment your shipment is delivered. Withdraw to any bank account 24/7 via your Flaship Wallet.

Get paid faster →

Analytics Dashboard

Track delivery performance, volume trends, and courier comparison data with clear, intuitive dashboards built for sellers.

See analytics →

Bulk Shipment Booking

Upload orders via CSV or book via API. Download all shipping labels and load sheets in one click. Scale without limits.

Start bulk booking →

Returns Management

Powerful returns module tracks received, in-transit, and processed returns. Full visibility on every return across all couriers.

Manage returns →
